title: Mirko Peters – Microsoft MVP, M365.FM podcast host & M365Con organizer
meta: Mirko Peters is a Microsoft MVP and host of the M365.FM podcast about Microsoft 365, Copilot, Azure and AI. Organizer of the free online conference M365Con.
lede: Mirko Peters is a Microsoft MVP who explains Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric and AI agents for IT admins, architects, developers and decision makers. He hosts the podcast M365.FM and the m365 Show on YouTube, and organizes the free online conference M365Con.
li1: Microsoft MVP – recognized by Microsoft for his work in the community (official MVP profile)
li2: Host of M365.FM – the podcast on Microsoft 365, Copilot, Azure, Power Platform and security, with interviews and explainer episodes
li3: Creator of the m365 Show on YouTube – animated explainers (Sticky Man Explained) and Microsoft certification courses
li4: Organizer of M365Con – a free, 100% online conference, Jan 11–22, 2027, with 120 sessions
li5: Author – publishes e-books on Microsoft topics under the name Mirko Peters
c1p: M365.FM covers Microsoft 365, Copilot, Azure, Power Platform and security – practical, from real projects, with conversations with Microsoft MVPs, product experts and architects, plus short daily explainer episodes.
c2p: The m365 Show on YouTube turns complex Microsoft topics into short animated explainers and certification courses, now also available as AI-dubbed audio in {N} languages on this site.
c3p: M365Con is a free, 100% online conference (Jan 11–22, 2027) with 120 sessions by speakers from the global Microsoft community, organized by Mirko Peters.
c4p: Mirko Peters writes e-books about Microsoft 365 and related topics for IT admins, architects and decision makers.
bio_p: Mirko Peters is a Microsoft MVP, podcaster, author and conference organizer focused on Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, Azure and AI agents. He hosts the podcast M365.FM and the m365 Show on YouTube, publishes the animated explainer series Sticky Man Explained, and organizes the free online conference M365Con. His content is aimed at IT admins, architects, developers and decision makers who want to understand the Microsoft cloud without marketing noise. The M365.FM episodes on this site are available as AI-dubbed audio in {N} languages.
